candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a no-op (remove the call) so withdrawAll no longer transfers funds.
Change onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner (invert check) so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners only, altering who can change contract balance.
Replace transfer with call to send value and forward gas, which changes reentrancy and failure behavior of withdraw.
Change onlyOwner modifier to check owner using tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering who is permitted to call withdraw and thus observable withdraw behavior.
Remove onlyOwner guard from withdraw so anyone can call withdraw, changing observable behavior of withdraw.
